findings.evidence: tools/inventory/src/main.rs:205 excludes null defaults. The pinned schema sets queue_rules.batch_max_failure_resolution_attempts and merge_queue.checking_label to null by default; neither has a default entry.
cargo run -q -p inventory -- --check: up to date. cargo test -p schlange-config --test coverage: 7 passed, including exact-one-feature assignment.

queue-bot-accounts.md:4-5 marks P2 and arztagent false. The pinned merge-queue_rules.md says unset draft_bot_account and merge_bot_account make the app create drafts and merge; both defaults apply to Arztagent.

commands.md:22-28 omits a pending queue command, cancellation on a foreign push, replacement by a differently named queue command, and dequeue of a pending command. These behaviours are specified in .research/mergify/commands_queue.md and commands_dequeue.md.

queue-labels-comments.md:34 calls the default queue_controls_comment operating hints. .research/mergify/commands_queue.md, 'Queueing with a Checkbox', specifies actionable queue and requeue checkboxes subject to command restrictions.

queue-bisection.md:24 says reaching the attempt limit dequeues all. .research/mergify/merge-queue_batches.md, 'Limiting Resolution Attempts', says the failing part is dequeued, preceding passing parts merge, and later parts return to the queue.

cargo test --workspace passed, and sim run scenarios/p0-queue-conditions.yaml passed, but the scenario reports I0–I5 not_checked and queue, merge conditions, dequeue codes, and fault injection as placeholders. The listed MQ cases have no covering test or scenario.

summary: The generated entries are current and assigned exactly once, but omitted null defaults, a P1 misclassification, and inaccurate command, checkbox, and bisection descriptions prevent a conformant feature map. Workspace tests and the available scenario passed. No repository files were changed.
